description: A query over an empty capture does not observe an unrelated ranked sibling.
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision
%rule text ($x:empty (ε | r10)) %conditions $x.without-elision.matches(empty)

%rule empty ε
%rule r0 (a ≻ b) :: ∅
%rule a [+T] :: ∅
%rule b [+U] :: ∅
%rule r1 (r0 r0) | [+V]
%rule r2 (r1 r1) | [+V]
%rule r3 (r2 r2) | [+V]
%rule r4 (r3 r3) | [+V]
%rule r5 (r4 r4) | [+V]
%rule r6 (r5 r5) | [+V]
%rule r7 (r6 r6) | [+V]
%rule r8 (r7 r7) | [+V]
%rule r9 (r8 r8) | [+V]
%rule r10 (r9 r9) | [+V]
